Load conflict and mobilization data

Source: R/conflict_data.R
conflict_data.Rd

Loads one of thirteen conflict, protest, or revolutionary episode datasets bundled with the package. scad, ucdp_prio, ucdp_vpp, mm, mmad, arc, and navco3.0 are returned at the country-year level; their event- or conflict-level source rows are aggregated inside this function.

navco1.3, beissinger, raqed, and mec return campaign or episode records, and omg returns campaign-phase records; navco2.1 returns campaign-year rows. These sources can contain multiple rows for one country-year. Use add_conflict(aggregate = TRUE) (the default) to collapse them to country-year.

Usage

conflict_data(
  start_year = 1945,
  end_year = 2013,
  dataset = c("navco1.3", "navco2.1", "beissinger", "raqed", "scad", "ucdp_prio",
    "ucdp_vpp", "mm", "mmad", "mec", "omg", "arc", "navco3.0"),
  coding_system = c("cow", "gw"),
  unit = c("year", "quarter", "month", "day")
)

Source

NAVCO 2.1: doi:10.7910/DVN/MHOXDV .

Beissinger Revolutionary Episodes: https://web.archive.org/web/20250331220952/https://mbeissinger.scholar.princeton.edu/revolutionary-episodes-dataset.

RAQED: https://social.hse.ru/mr/rev_bd.

OMG: https://www.prio.org/data/39.

ARC 2.0: doi:10.7910/DVN/C0PUHP .

NAVCO 3.0: doi:10.7910/DVN/INNYEO .

SCAD: https://www.strausscenter.org/ccaps-research-areas/social-conflict/database/.

UCDP: https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/replication_data.html.

MMAD: https://mmadatabase.org/.

MEC: Chenoweth and Kang (2026), doi:10.1093/jopres/xjaf008 ; data release doi:10.7910/DVN/JQWQNW .

Arguments

start_year

First year to include.

end_year

Last year to include.

dataset

Dataset to load. One of:

"navco1.3"

NAVCO 1.3 campaign onsets. Coverage: 1900-2019.

"navco2.1"

NAVCO 2.1 campaign-years. Coverage: 1945-2013.

"beissinger"

Beissinger revolutionary episode onsets. Coverage: 1900-2014.

"raqed"

Revolutionary and Quasi-revolutionary Episodes Dataset (RAQED) v1.4, HSE University. Episode records. Coverage: 2000-2026. Prefix: raqed_.

"scad"

SCAD 2018 social conflict events, Africa and Latin America. Recorded event starts: 1989-2017 (the 1989 event continues into the source's 1990 coverage period). Prefix: scad_.

"ucdp_prio"

UCDP/PRIO Armed Conflict Dataset v26.1. Coverage: 1946-2025. Prefix: ucdp_prio_.

"ucdp_vpp"

UCDP Violent Political Protest Dataset v26.1. Coverage: 1989-2025. Prefix: ucdp_vpp_. Requires the readxl package.

"mm"

Mass Mobilization Project v4 (Clark and Regan). Coverage: 1990-2020. Prefix: mm_.

"mmad"

Mass Mobilization in Autocracies Database. Coverage: 2003-2022. Prefix: mmad_.

"mec"

Major Episodes of Contention. Global coverage: 1955-2018. Episode records; prefix: mec_.

"omg"

Opposition Movements and Groups (OMG) v1. Campaign-phase records. Coverage: 1789-2019, for the countries coded so far. Prefix: omg_.

"arc"

Anatomy of Resistance Campaigns (ARC) 2.0: protest and armed-conflict events from SCAD and UCDP GED with the formal organizations that took part, Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean. Coverage: 1990-2018. Prefix: arc_.

"navco3.0"

NAVCO 3.0 events on 26 countries (1990-2012): actions by anti-government campaigns, states, and others, with tactics, goals, and state responses. Prefix: nvc3.0_.

coding_system

Country coding system: "cow" or "gw". ucdp_prio and ucdp_vpp use GW codes natively; when coding_system = "cow" they are converted via countrycode and countries without a COW equivalent are dropped.

unit

Time unit of the returned data: "year" (default), "quarter", "month", or "day". Event datasets are aggregated to this unit, and campaign and episode records are placed in the period of their start date. Records whose source date is less precise than unit (a quarter needs a month-precise date) are dropped with a message. "navco1.3", "navco2.1", "ucdp_prio", and "ucdp_vpp" support "year" only.

Value

A data frame. navco1.3, beissinger, raqed, and mec contain one row per campaign or episode record; omg contains one row per campaign phase; navco2.1 contains campaign-year rows. The other datasets contain one row per country-year.

Details

All outputs use the requested cow or gw key and year. Dataset-specific columns have a stable source prefix. A missing country-year row is not created by this loader; after add_conflict(), an unmatched year is NA, not an assumed zero.

SCAD is deduplicated to one row per event before country-year aggregation. Its UCDP placeholder rows are excluded, and documented negative codes for unknown death counts are treated as missing.

For UCDP/PRIO, ucdp_prio_incidence identifies any active conflict-year and ucdp_prio_onset identifies a new episode using the source's start_date2. The VPP source does not include an episode-start variable; ucdp_vpp_incidence should be preferred. The legacy ucdp_vpp_onset column is retained as an incidence alias for compatibility.

The Mass Mobilization source mixes exact participant counts with text such as ranges and inequalities. mm_participants is the maximum among genuinely numeric values; mm_participants_reported preserves the source strings.

Country codes. COW codes follow the package's COW panels: the German Federal Republic is 255 and Czechoslovakia 316 (see build_states_panel()), and Yemen is 678 up to 1990 and 679 from 1991. GW codes are derived from COW by year: Germany is GW 255 up to 1945 and 260 after; Serbia is GW 340 up to 1915 and from June 2006, and 345 (Yugoslavia) in between; Czechoslovakia is GW 315 and the Czech Republic 316; Yemen is GW 678; Vietnam is 816 in both systems. The Mass Mobilization data's non-COW codes (for example 341 for Kosovo and 525 for South Sudan) are mapped to COW first.

MEC is kept at its published episode level. Its source byear becomes year, ccode becomes cow, and all other source columns receive the mec_ prefix. mec_episode equals one for every returned episode record. Fourteen left-censored records have an actual mec_bdate before 1955 while their source byear is 1955.

RAQED is kept at its published episode level. year is the episode's start_year; all other source columns receive the raqed_ prefix. raqed_onset equals one for every episode, and raqed_type_re, raqed_type_re_q, and raqed_type_qre are dummies for the source type (revolutionary episode, questionable revolutionary episode, and quasi-revolutionary episode). Abkhazia, Hong Kong, Palestine, Puerto Rico, and Western Sahara have no COW code and are omitted.

OMG is kept at its published campaign-phase level. year is the phase's start_year. omg_phase_onset equals one for every phase and omg_onset equals one only for the first phase of a campaign (omg_campaign_id), so later phases of an ongoing campaign are not counted as new onsets. The source identifies countries by V-Dem country_id; these are converted with countrycode. Serbia is mapped to COW 345 / GW 340, Yemen to COW 678 before 1990 and 679 from 1990 (GW 678), and Piedmont-Sardinia to 325. Hong Kong, Palestine, and Western Sahara are omitted. OMG covers only the countries coded so far, so a missing country-year is not evidence that no campaign occurred.

NAVCO 3.0 records individual actions by anti-government campaigns (actor_id 2), states (1), and international, non-aligned, and local state actors. nvc3.0_onset is one when at least one campaign action occurred in the period and zero when only actions by other actors did. nvc3.0_n_nonviolent, nvc3.0_n_violent, and nvc3.0_n_mixed count campaign actions by tactical_choice; nvc3.0_n_regime_change counts campaign actions with regime-change goals; nvc3.0_n_concessions (st_posture 1-3), nvc3.0_n_repression (5-7), and nvc3.0_n_lethal_repression (7) count state responses. The source records fatalities, injuries, and participants as numbers or ranges ("100-300"); the _low and _high columns sum (fatalities, injuries) or take the maximum (participants in campaign actions) of the range bounds.

Mass Mobilization codes country-years in which no protest occurred as a row with protest = 0; these give mm_onset = 0 and mm_n_protests = 0. They have no date, so they are absent from country-month and country-day data.

ARC 2.0 lists one row per event, with the participating ARC organization IDs in a comma-separated org_id (missing when no formal organization was identified). Events are assigned to the year in which they start and aggregated to country-year: arc_n_events (split into arc_n_events_scad and arc_n_events_ged), arc_n_maximalist and arc_n_nonmaximalist (by the source's maximalist flag; every GED event is maximalist), arc_n_nonviolent_scad, arc_n_events_org and arc_share_events_org (events with at least one identified organization), and arc_n_orgs (distinct organizations active in that country-year).

Examples

navco <- conflict_data(1990, 2010, dataset = "navco2.1", coding_system = "cow")

scad  <- conflict_data(1995, 2015, dataset = "scad",      coding_system = "cow")

ucdp  <- conflict_data(1990, 2020, dataset = "ucdp_prio", coding_system = "gw")

mec   <- conflict_data(1990, 2010, dataset = "mec",       coding_system = "cow")

raqed <- conflict_data(2000, 2025, dataset = "raqed",     coding_system = "cow")

omg   <- conflict_data(1900, 2019, dataset = "omg",       coding_system = "gw")

arc   <- conflict_data(1990, 2018, dataset = "arc",       coding_system = "cow")

navco3 <- conflict_data(2011, 2012, dataset = "navco3.0", coding_system = "cow",
                        unit = "month")
